policy: Reference photos stay under Review; none of their pixels, logos or proprietary meshes are imported into the game. New models and MOA labels are project-authored. Existing material provenance remains in the prior asset registers.

sources.name: IKEA STENSELE cafe table
sources.creator: IKEA; designer Maja Ganszyniec
sources.license: Copyrighted retailer reference; not an imported game asset
sources.confirmed: 70 x 70 cm table option; laminate surface, plastic edge, powder-coated metal pedestal. Photo shows curved chair backs, upholstered seats and branched table feet.
sources.not_confirmed: Any Korean supermarket branch inventory or furniture location; round-table dimensions; exact chair dimensions
sources.authored_use: B1 cafe and restaurant: 0.86 m round, 0.80 m square, 1.05 x 0.70 m rectangular tabletops; original curved plywood, cushioned and open slat chairs. Dimensions and arrangement are game design choices. No traced mesh.

sources.not_confirmed: Exact supermarket assortment, dimensions, material roughness or planogram

sources.name: Redence skincare product form reference
